overview: This enum names the gamepad buttons and stick directions that form the game button bit words.

None.technical: uint32 bit word 0. The controller input-guide row constructor initializes InputKey to EInputKey::None. An unmapped EGameInputKey returns 0 from GetGameKeyButtons, which is the same word.

Circle.simple: The right face button on the gamepad.
Circle.technical: uint32 bit 1. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_FaceButton_Right. The default game-key map binds it to NormalAttack_3.

Cross.simple: The bottom face button on the gamepad.
Cross.technical: uint32 bit 2. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom. The default game-key map binds it to Jump, and the framework widget manager reads it for the accept action.

Triangle.simple: The top face button on the gamepad.
Triangle.technical: uint32 bit 4. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_FaceButton_Top. The default game-key map binds it to NormalAttack_2 and ScriptAuto.

Square.simple: The left face button on the gamepad.
Square.technical: uint32 bit 8. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_FaceButton_Left. The default game-key map binds it to NormalAttack_1, and the framework widget manager reads it for the cancel action.

DPad_Left.simple: The left direction of the D-pad.
DPad_Left.technical: uint32 bit 16. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_DPad_Left. It drives left menu navigation and the default PlayableCharacterChangeLeft binding.

DPad_Right.simple: The right direction of the D-pad.
DPad_Right.technical: uint32 bit 32. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_DPad_Right. It drives right menu navigation and the default PlayableCharacterChangeRight binding.

DPad_Up.simple: The up direction of the D-pad.
DPad_Up.technical: uint32 bit 64. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_DPad_Up. It drives up menu navigation and joins LeftStick_Up in the default WidgetUp word.

DPad_Down.simple: The down direction of the D-pad.
DPad_Down.technical: uint32 bit 128. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_DPad_Down. It drives down menu navigation and joins LeftStick_Down in the default WidgetDown word.

R1.technical: uint32 bit 256. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_RightShoulder. The default game-key map binds it to NextMenu, OnlineSequencerSkip and CursedEnergyAttack_1.

L1.technical: uint32 bit 512. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_LeftShoulder. The default game-key map binds it to Dash and PrevMenu.

R2.technical: uint32 bit 1024. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_RightTrigger. The default game-key map binds it to NextContent and CursedEnergyAttack_2.

L2.technical: uint32 bit 2048. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_LeftTrigger. The default game-key map binds it to Pagination, PrevContent and Guard.

R3.technical: uint32 bit 4096. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_RightThumbstick. The default game-key map binds it to Filter and CameraModeChange.

L3.technical: uint32 bit 8192. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_LeftThumbstick. The default game-key map binds it to WidgetDispSwitchMenu, MainMenuThemeOpen, OperationTargetChange and WidgetDispSwitch.

Start.simple: The Start button on the gamepad.
Start.technical: uint32 bit 16384. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_Special_Right. The default game-key map binds it to Option and BattlePause.

Back.simple: The Back button on the gamepad.
Back.technical: uint32 bit 32768. PollButtons sets it from Gamepad_Special_Left. The default game-key map binds it to Select.

LeftStick_Left.simple: The left direction of the left stick.
LeftStick_Left.technical: uint32 bit 65536. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected LeftX is below -LeftStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. The bit keys a 0.2 second flick timer and the default MoveLeft binding.

LeftStick_Right.simple: The right direction of the left stick.
LeftStick_Right.technical: uint32 bit 131072. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected LeftX is above LeftStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. The bit keys a 0.2 second flick timer and the default MoveRight binding.

LeftStick_Up.simple: The up direction of the left stick.
LeftStick_Up.technical: uint32 bit 262144. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected LeftY is above LeftStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. The bit keys a 0.2 second flick timer and joins DPad_Up in the default WidgetUp word.

LeftStick_Down.simple: The down direction of the left stick.
LeftStick_Down.technical: uint32 bit 524288. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected LeftY is below -LeftStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. The bit keys a 0.2 second flick timer and joins DPad_Down in the default WidgetDown word.

RightStick_Left.simple: The left direction of the right stick.
RightStick_Left.technical: uint32 bit 1048576. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected RightX is below -RightStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. The default game-key map binds it to CameraLeft and TargetChangeLeft.

RightStick_Right.simple: The right direction of the right stick.
RightStick_Right.technical: uint32 bit 2097152. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected RightX is above RightStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. The default game-key map binds it to CameraRight and TargetChangeRight.

RightStick_Up.simple: The up direction of the right stick.
RightStick_Up.technical: uint32 bit 4194304. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected RightY is below -RightStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. Negative RightY is the up direction here. The default game-key map binds it to CameraUp.

RightStick_Down.simple: The down direction of the right stick.
RightStick_Down.technical: uint32 bit 8388608. PollButtons sets it when dead-zone-corrected RightY is above RightStickThreshold, which AGameInputManager defaults to 0.25. Positive RightY is the down direction here. The default game-key map binds it to CameraDown and TargetChangeNear.

DPad.simple: Any direction on the D-pad as one combined word.
DPad.technical: uint32 composite value 240, the OR of DPad_Left, DPad_Right, DPad_Up and DPad_Down. No reconstructed source reads the composite name. PollButtons emits each component bit separately.

LeftStick.simple: Any direction of the left stick as one combined word.
LeftStick.technical: uint32 composite value 983040, the OR of the four LeftStick direction bits. No reconstructed source reads the composite name. PollButtons emits each component bit separately.

RightStick.simple: Any direction of the right stick as one combined word.
RightStick.technical: uint32 composite value 14680064, the OR of the four RightStick direction bits. No reconstructed source reads the composite name. PollButtons emits each component bit separately.

Any.simple: Any face button or shoulder button on the gamepad.
Any.technical: uint32 value 3855, the OR of Circle, Cross, Triangle, Square, R1, L1, R2 and L2. IsButtonPressed intersects the word with newly pressed buttons, so the skip-appearance and story-footer widgets treat any of those buttons as input.

notes: EInputKey.h declares no Invalid member. The Invalid sentinel in controller guide code belongs to EGameInputKey and returns 0 through GetGameKeyButtons when it has no binding.
The controller input-guide image lookup compares the complete 32 bit word by equality. Composite bindings such as WidgetUp need a row with the exact combined word.
Saved key rebinding can change GameKeyButtonMap. The button meanings above are the default map in the reconstructed source.
Button words are tested with bitwise intersection by IsButtonPressed and IsButtonHeld. The controller input-guide image table is the consumer that uses exact equality.
